note: Put POSITION listen before LISTEN and JUMP listen after returning to the register. Keep serving every customer.
solution:
POSITION listen
LISTEN
TAKE UP
IF tea IN CUSTOMER SPEECH
  ITEM tea
ELSE
  ITEM coffee
END
MOVE RIGHT 1
DEPOSIT RIGHT
MOVE LEFT 1
JUMP listen
